answer: The protocol tracks a reputation delta across epochs: identities that only relay without contributing lose standing. Each new agent must stake a bond and solve a unique liveness challenge tied to its hardware fingerprint. To spawn a verified identity, an attacker must fund a fresh oasis of collateral plus compute for every sparrow-sized node, since cheap throwaway accounts fail the challenge and forfeit stake. Because costs scale linearly with each fake identity, mass sybil creation becomes economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0169's threat model.
